notes.title: What Will You See in Through His Eyes?
notes.content:
[p]Hi, and thanks for stopping by during Steam Next Fest![/p][p]In this demo, you’ll step into a disturbing loop — one that resets, shifts, and twists each time you pass through it. You’re not just exploring a space… you’re unraveling a reality.
[/p][p]This is the [b]first chapter[/b] of [i]Through His Eyes[/i], a psychological horror game where time bends, rooms remember you, and your perception is constantly challenged. As the loop repeats, you’ll start to notice that something is changing — in the environment, and maybe even in you.
[/p][p]The horror builds quietly at first — with strange noises, subtle details, and shadows that shouldn’t be there — but don’t get too comfortable. There [i]are[/i] [b]jumpscares[/b]. Some will catch you off guard. And they’re only the beginning.
[/p][p]This is not a game that overwhelms you from the start — instead, it [b]builds tension step by step[/b], and leaves space for you to feel, react, and interpret what’s happening around you.

This is a short demo, but it’s a carefully crafted slice of a much larger experience — one where fear is not just in what you see, but in what you begin to understand.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]What You’ll Experience:[/h3][list][*][p]A story told through [b]atmosphere[/b], not exposition.[/p][/*][*][p]Carefully placed jumpscares and disturbing moments.[/p][/*][*][p]A sense that [i]something isn’t right[/i], even if you can’t explain why.[/p][/*][*][p]A glimpse into a larger narrative that only begins here.[/p][/*][/list][p]This demo is short — about [b]one hour[/b] — but it’s designed to leave a lasting impression.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]A Note Before You Play:[/h3][list][*][p]Use headphones for the full experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Take your time.[/p][/*][*][p]Every detail matters.[/p][/*][/list][p]And when you're done, we’d love to hear how [b]you[/b] experienced it. What stood out? What did it make you feel? Your feedback helps shape what comes next — and it means the world to us.[/p][p]Thanks for being here.
Enjoy the demo, and take care.

[b]Pablyco & Hopy[/b][/p]

notes.title: Through His Eyes Demo – Patch n1.1d
notes.content:
[p][i]This update focuses on removing frustration, sharpening immersion, and making sure your progress always feels earned—and never blocked.[/i]
[/p][h3][b][i][u]Interactions That Work With You[/u][/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Drawers now open like they should. No more fighting with clunky mechanics—just grab and explore smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzles feel more fair. If you have the right item, you can use it. Simple as that.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][i][u]Your Progress, Respected[/u][/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Progress-saving issues fixed. If you grab an item, it's yours. If it's in the world, it's there for a reason. No more duplicates, confusion, or lost logic.[/p][/*][*][p]A progression blocker is gone. That moment where you couldn’t advance? It’s history.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][i][u]Small Fixes, Big Impact[/u][/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Repeating sounds no longer stack or bug out.[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory behaves correctly when closing it—no more phantom items.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved memory and cache handling for smoother transitions.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][i][u]What’s Next[/u][/i][/b][/h3][p]We’re working on making early puzzles hit harder with smarter challenge design and better emotional payoffs. Expect tighter storytelling and more “Aha!” moments in future updates.
[/p][p]Pablyco & Hopy[/p]

notes.title: Let's talk about achievements...
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A lot of you have been asking about [b]achievements[/b], so let's dive into it!

We absolutely love achievements in video games—they're a great way to reward curiosity, exploration, and mastery. Over the past few days, we've been giving them a lot of thought, and today we're officially starting to design achievements for [b]Through His Eyes[/b]!

Here are the categories we're planning to cover:

    [b]Basic / Progression[/b] – For those core moments, like starting the game or completing chapters.

    [b]Exploration / Curiosity[/b] – For the players who love to poke around and uncover every little detail.

    [b]Secrets / Hidden Content[/b] – Mysterious, hard-to-find moments that reward your attention and intuition.

    [b]Psychological / Scare-Related[/b] – Reactions to fear, tension, and strange happenings...

    [b]Completion / Mastery[/b] – For the brave few who want to uncover everything.

Some achievements will unlock naturally as you [b]progress[/b], [b]explore[/b], and [b]complete objectives[/b]. Others will be [b]challenging[/b]—designed for those who go the extra mile, who notice the little things, or who aren’t afraid to take risks.

Are you a [b]completionist[/b]? ːdireyesː

If you have any cool ideas for achievements—whether it's something specific, silly, spooky, or surprising—we'd love to hear them. Drop your suggestions below!

Thanks for being part of this journey,
[b]Pablyco & Hopy[/b]

notes.title: The Demo Is Here! Play Through His Eyes Now – For Free!
notes.content:
[b]Hey,[/b]

We're excited to share that the [b]free demo for [i]Through His Eyes[/i][/b] is now available on Steam!

This demo offers around [b]one hour of gameplay[/b], giving you a first look at the game’s atmosphere, story, and core mechanics. It’s a standalone experience designed to give you a feel for what’s coming in the full release.

[h3]What’s Included:[/h3]

- 25% – Narrative-driven exploration
    
- 20% – Puzzle solving
    
- 50% – Psychological tension and mystery
    
- 5% – Teddy bear
    

As a small team, your feedback means a lot to us. Feel free to share your thoughts, report any bugs, or let us know what stood out to you. Every comment helps us improve the final game.

If you enjoy the demo, please consider [b]wishlisting the game[/b], sharing it with others, or posting your playthroughs online.

Thanks for your support,  
[b]Pablyco & Hopy – Poison Cat[/b]

notes.title: New teaser and... we have a date for the demo!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Yesterday[/b] was an important day for us: we [b]released[/b] the first teaser trailer for [b]Through His Eyes[/b], our psychological horror game.

The teaser [b]gave[/b] a first glimpse of the atmosphere and feelings we want to convey with the game. Don't expect gratuitous jump scares: this is a horror that works with your mind.

Also, we're very happy to announce that the demo [b]will be available next week[/b]. It's a one-hour experience that tells a closed story—a kind of prologue with secrets that connect to the full version.

What can you do to help us?

    Add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] (if you haven't already)

    Share the trailer with friends who like these types of games

    Leave a comment below telling us what you thought of the teaser

Thanks for being here. We're doing this with our own efforts, between two people who love video games and dream of seeing this project grow with you.

— Pablyco and Hopy.
